name: Can I use a duplex as a house hack, and what are the benefits?

mainEntity.name: Can I use a duplex as a house hack, and what are the benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 'house hacking' with a duplex involves living in one unit while renting out the other. The primary benefit is that the rental income from the second unit can significantly offset your mortgage payment, reducing your housing costs. This strategy can also make it easier to qualify for a loan, as potential rental income is often considered. It's an excellent way to enter real estate investing with reduced financial burden. Kelby Contreras frequently guides first-time investors in Miami-Dade and Broward Counties on finding duplexes suitable for house hacking, providing insights into local rental markets.
acceptedAnswer.description: House hacking involves living in one unit and renting the other, using rental income to offset your mortgage. This strategy can reduce housing costs and aid loan qualification.
